title: Terminal and Gravity
author: Isandro Marchetti
blurb: Ulyana Sterling, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
